camel_example: aliyun cms DescribeSiteMonitorList --region cn-hangzhou --TaskId 'a1ecd34a-8157-44d9-b060-149508370000' --Keyword site --PageSize 10 --TaskType HTTP --AgentGroup PC --Page 1 --TaskState 1
description_en: Queries the list of site monitoring tasks by calling the DescribeSiteMonitorList operation
description_zh: 调用DescribeSiteMonitorList接口查询站点监控任务列表
kebab_example: aliyun cms describe-site-monitor-list --task-id a1ecd34a-8157-44d9-b060-149508370000 --task-type HTTP --keyword site --page 1 --page-size 10 --task-state 1 --agent-group PC --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSiteMonitorList

parameters.help_en: The ID of the site monitoring task
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the site monitoring task. CloudMonitor supports the following types: HTTP, PING, TCP, UDP, DNS, SMTP, POP3, and FTP
parameters.help_zh: 站点监控任务探测类型。云监控支持的探测类型包括：HTTP 、PING 、TCP 、UDP 、DNS 、SMTP 、POP3 、FTP
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en:
The keyword used to search for site monitoring tasks.

> Fuzzy match is supported based on the task name or task address
parameters.help_zh:
查询站点监控任务的关键字。

> 支持根据任务名称或任务地址模糊搜索
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The task status. Valid values:

- 1: Normal.

- 2: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态。取值：

- 1：正常。

- 2：禁用
parameters.name: task_state

parameters.help_en:
The type of detection points used by the task. Valid values:

- PC: PC-based detection points.

- MOBILE: mobile-based detection points.

- FC: internal detection points
parameters.help_zh:
任务使用的节点类型。取值：

- PC：PC端探测点。

- MOBILE：移动端探测点。

- FC：内网探测点
parameters.name: agent_group
